confirmation_policy: All Train history is known development evidence; no independent OOS, Historical Valid or Valid access.

feature_definitions.ResidualReturn: provided raw_return - provided beta * provided TOPIX on exact Date/Code, finite only, identical existing market residual primitive; no fitted beta/factor model
feature_definitions.IndustryResidualReturn: each historical date u, actual present raw_return rows with exact PIT17(u); self-inclusive equal mean of finite ResidualReturn, minimum5; missing/9999/blank excluded. No LOO or signal-date membership retrospectively applied
feature_definitions.StockMom20: within unchanged Code/relisting segments: residual.shift(1).rolling(20,min_periods=20).sum(); one skipped current observation, prior20 observations ending at preceding observed stock row
feature_definitions.IndustryMom20: industry residual daily history on raw-return exchange calendar; shift1 then rolling20 min20 sum; missing/insufficient-member dates stay NaN, not compressed; map current PIT17(t) to that industry history
feature_definitions.timing: both horizon20/skip1/previous-observation endpoint. Stock uses existing per-Code observed rows; industry uses industry exchange observations. Stock gaps can mean different calendar spans, saved as diagnostic; no alternate timing trial
feature_definitions.Within17Rev20: -Within17Mom20; sign registered from external literature, not post-hoc sign reversal of previous Train candidates
feature_definitions.scaling: unchanged same-date centered average percentile rank on finite raw values, zero missing after transform; each component separately
feature_definitions.missing: raw retains NaN for coverage. component ranks neutral0 after ranking; combined raw coverage requires both finite, predictions cover every required row. No availability filter
feature_definitions.state: existing >20 absent exchange-date relisting segment reset; sector change keeps per-Code EWMA history; no extra reset

model: DM-20261002-10 combined formula with PIT Sector33 replaced by PIT Sector17 only. No fit or search.
selection_rule: One new robustness trial only. Apply unchanged DM-20261002-10 feasibility and combined-adoption gates against MOM60. If any fail REJECT; all pass NEXT_STAGE_ELIGIBLE only, not deployment. Primary17-minus33 robustness metrics are descriptive; no new thresholds or rescue. Prior10 decisions unchanged.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block on identical concatenated eligible sessions

diagnostics.component_rankic: raw Industry continuation and Within reversal IC/HAC5/hit across all required rows and matched joint-finite17/33 raw rows; cross-industry IC additionally, no component portfolios
diagnostics.coverage: raw Stock/Industry/Within and final-score finite coverage separately, ALL_TRAIN/POOLED/EX2016/year/sector; minimum5 unchanged
diagnostics.persistence: same rank autocorrelation/quintile retention/tail spells/percentile changes; no filter
diagnostics.concentration: all3 official books evaluated using BOTH PIT17 and PIT33 partitions; compare book concentration on same partition; no sector exclusion or rerank
diagnostics.comparison: all official metrics including Long/Short net/gross/SR/cost/turnover, Q1-Q5,2011-2015 full years,2016partial, EX2016, paired bootstrap. Descriptive matched-row IC is not another portfolio
